title: Casablanca Finance City / Casa Anfa district: building brief and OSM layout

coordinate_frame.origin: area centroid of OSM way 871612907 "Tour CFC First" (CFC Tower)
coordinate_frame.axes: x = metres EAST, z = metres SOUTH (z = -north offset), y up. Equirectangular projection at origin latitude, R = 6371008.8 m.
coordinate_frame.formulas: x = (lon - lon0) * pi/180 * R * cos(lat0); z = -(lat - lat0) * pi/180 * R
coordinate_frame.bearing_convention: obb_long_axis_bearing_deg = compass bearing (deg clockwise from true north, 0-180) of the long side of the minimum-area bounding rectangle

district.name: Casa Anfa (Pole urbain Casa Anfa) / Casablanca Finance City business district
facts: Built on the former Casablanca-Anfa airport, closed in 2007. About 350 ha in total; master plan by Reichen & Robert & Associes (2006 competition). Developer: AUDA, a CDG subsidiary.
Programme: about 2,300,000 m2 housing and 1,300,000 m2 offices (voyages-d-affaires).
Anfa Park: phase 1 of 18 ha opened 11 March 2020; 50 ha planned in total. In OSM the polygon "Anfa Park" (way 586647221) covers about 16.3 ha.
The street grid around the CFC Tower is rotated about 20-23 deg clockwise from true north. OSM building long axes cluster at about 20 deg and about 110 deg bearing.

Casablanca tramway line T2 crosses the district. Stops near the tower: "Place Financiere" (about 141 m south of the CFC Tower), "Abdellah Ben Cherif", "Anfa Park" and "Anfa Clubs". Busway BW2 has stops "Les Musees", "Oued Oum Rabia" and "C.I.L.".

Boulevard Al Massira: no way with that name in the retrieved bbox. Bd de l'Aeropostale, Main Street, Bd Moulay Abdellah Cherif, Bd des Musees, Bd Sidi Abderrahmane, Bd d'Oued Oum Rabia, Bd du Grand Theatre and Bd des Clubs are present.

inventory.name: Casablanca Finance City Tower (Tour CFC)
inventory.owner_occupant: Casablanca Finance City Authority (client and HQ). A 2018 report says CFCA takes the top two floors and Bank Al-Maghrib banking supervision the next four, with the other floors let to CFC-status companies. OSM also has an office node "Orange Middle East and Africa" inside the footprint.
inventory.year: 2019. Handover is given as Feb 2019 (Bymaro) or April 2019 (Morphosis via WA). Construction ran 2015/2016 to 2019.

height_m.note: Morphosis and Arch Record give about 400 ft / 122 m, as do FR Wikipedia, Bymaro and the OSM height tag. WA and Yabiladi give 121 m. CTBUH and EN Wikipedia give 136 m as architectural height. 136 m may count the crown or mesh armature; this is unverified.

inventory.architect: Morphosis (Thom Mayne), design architect; Omar Alaoui Architectes, architect of record
inventory.team: Structure: Thornton Tomasetti (design) and Tractebel (EOR); post-tensioned slabs by VSL (32,000 m2). MEP: Arup and Tractebel. Facade consultant: VS-A. Brise-soleil and curtain wall: Simeon (prefabricated in Italy). Glass: Guardian. Contractor: Bouygues Construction / Bymaro. Exterior lighting: Erco.
inventory.plan_shape: Not described in text sources. OSM maps it as a simple 4-vertex quadrilateral, nearly square. The real plan is faceted, with tapering top and base, so OSM is a simplification.
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: about 35.4 x 30.1 m, area about 1,070 m2. Sides run about 23 deg clockwise from true north, aligned with the Casa Anfa street grid.
inventory.massing: Tapers at both top and base, which Morphosis calls a "double crown". The top is a shard-like tapered crown with a glass top and mesh armature, holding an open-air event space with green walls. The base is prismatic with canted walls forming a dynamic lobby and touches the ground lightly. The midsection is a straight shaft. No podium.
inventory.facade: White fixed, angled, textured brise-soleil wraps the midsection. It was designed in concrete and built in aluminium for cost. Modules sit at varying depths, inspired by Moroccan mosaics and wooden latticework screens. Behind it is low-E insulated glazing with a frit pattern. The upper part reportedly has glazing with integrated PV and a double-glazed facade acting as a thermal chimney (BD+C, via search summary).
inventory.distinctive: All-white lattice tower and the tallest in Casablanca Finance City. Sources do not document the tapered crown being lit at night or any rooftop signage. LEED Gold.
inventory.orientation: Faces not documented. The grid-aligned footprint means facades face about 23/113/203/293 deg.

inventory.name: BCP Tower (Tour de la Banque Centrale Populaire)
inventory.owner_occupant: Banque Centrale Populaire (Groupe BCP) headquarters, Anfa Lot 64
inventory.year: Dates conflict. EN Wikipedia gives construction 2022-2023; TESS gives the design period 2015-2021; Yabiladi gives 2019-2024; the Wikipedia list gives 2025. Medias24 (June 2025) reported "ready, move imminent". Recognised at the Architectural Record Awards 2025.

height_m.note: 105.4 m from CTBUH, OSM and the Wikipedia list. 120 m roof from the EN Wikipedia infobox and TESS. About 100 m from Medias24 (2016, 2025).

inventory.architect: Groupe 3 Architectes (G3A) with Cabinet Rachid Andaloussi. TESS Engineering for structure, glass facades and GRC.
inventory.plan_shape: Rectangle (slab). Two simple parallelepipeds: the slab tower attached to a podium.
inventory.footprint_m: OSM tower: about 49.3 x 22.5 m, area about 1,090 m2. Long axis bearing about 110 deg, so the broad faces point about NNE and SSW. Medias24 2016 said "about 20 m thick". The podium is not separately identified in OSM.
inventory.massing: Straight-sided slab tower on a 5-storey podium. No taper. Suspended gardens are mentioned (Yabiladi). Crown not described.
inventory.facade: NORTH: double skin of large glass modules, 2.70 m wide x 3.6 m high. The outer skin is one large glass pane per module, with a ventilated open joint at each floor; the inner skin is glazed frames on mixed opaque/glazed fire-resistant sills. SOUTH: GRC (glass-fibre reinforced concrete) moucharabieh screen of 1.80 m square panels whose solid/void density varies across the face. Behind it, a set-back inner facade of full-height glazed frames 1.35 m wide. BLIND GABLES (short ends): same GRC pattern, fully solid panels. GRC colour not stated in sources.
inventory.distinctive: Two contrasting long faces: a sleek glass north face and a mashrabiya-screened south face. A BCP logo is mounted on the facade (Medias24 2025); its position is not stated.
inventory.orientation: Main facades face north and south (TESS); the OSM long axis is about 110 deg.

inventory.name: AWB Tower / Borj Attijariwafa (Borj Attijari)
inventory.owner_occupant: Attijariwafa bank, group headquarters per Viguier. A 2018 Le360 report said the HQ would stay on Bd Moulay Youssef; later project material calls it the HQ.
inventory.status: completed or near-complete. Viguier says delivery 2025-2026; the Wikipedia list says completed 2025.

height_m.note: 114 m from the Wikipedia list. About 113 m (371 ft) roof from SkyscraperPage, per search snippet (site offline when fetched). 110 m from the SkyscraperCity thread title. The architect gives no metres.

floors.note: 25: Viguier and Figueras. 27: Omteq, Le360 2018 and the Wikipedia list.

inventory.architect: VIGUIER architecture urbanisme paysage (lead), with Uni Archi (Ghali Chaoui, Hani Hejira) as associate. Facades: Ferres Arquitectos. Engineering: Omteq and Ingerop. Contractors: Sogea Maroc (structure) and CMS (general). Project management: Hill International and Marodec.
inventory.footprint_m: unknown: no AWB / Attijariwafa building is named in the OSM data retrieved
inventory.massing: A 25-storey tower plus four office buildings, which Viguier gives as R+6 in its details and 8 storeys in its intro; Omteq says R+7. A central garden extends onto terraces and loggias, and an internal street links the halls. The top floor has a sheltered shared terrace.
inventory.facade: Stone, per Viguier, with mouldings giving an institutional look. Openable windows in every other bay. Solar shading. Stone colour not stated. A façade-conference profile credits the Viguier project manager with designing a "GRC façade". Conflict: possibly GRC with a stone-like finish, unverified. A SkyscraperCity post mentions white cladding with glass on upper floors, which is not authoritative.
inventory.distinctive: Includes a 428-seat telescopic-tribune auditorium (Figueras). HQE, LEED and BREEAM targeted.
inventory.orientation: unknown. The offices "open onto Parc Anfa".
inventory.location_note: Described as "near Anfa Park" and in the heart of CFC. The exact lot was not found. Do not place it without further evidence.

inventory.name: Tour CIMR (CIMR headquarters)
inventory.owner_occupant: CIMR (Caisse Interprofessionnelle Marocaine de Retraite) headquarters
inventory.year: 2022; occupied from 4 April 2022, about two years late

height_m.note: DL2A, Le360 and OSM all give 60 m

floors.value: ground + 14 office floors + 2 top floors (plenary/executive), roughly R+16; 4 basement parking levels
floors.note: DL2A text is ambiguous about whether the top two floors are included in the 14

inventory.architect: D.L.2.A, Didier Lefort Architectes Associes (architecture and interiors)
inventory.plan_shape: Curved, soft forms: three interlocking towers of different heights (a symbol of intergenerational solidarity)
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: 18-vertex rounded polygon about 31.2 x 24.0 m, about 600 m2. The plot is 1,450 m2. Sits at the corner of two main avenues.
inventory.massing: Three interlocking rounded volumes stepping in height. Landscaped roof terrace. Total 60 m.
inventory.facade: Double skin of WHITE perforated aluminium sheet running from ground level up, with a veil-like effect. The perforation pattern reproduces the CIMR logo and cuts solar gain by about 60%. Inner facade of full-height double glazing set 85 cm behind.
inventory.distinctive: Soft white perforated "veil" over curved volumes. HQE Excellent.

inventory.name: Casa Business Towers (CBT): "Tour Mainstreet", "Tour Casa Anfa" and "Le Metropolitain"
inventory.owner_occupant: Offices to let or sell. The CBT site says "Projet signé IRG" without stating IRG's role.

height_m.note: "90 m" appears in a CBT image caption without saying what it measures. The OSM height tag is 90 for each tower and 30 for Le Metropolitain.

inventory.plan_shape: Rectangular slabs, from OSM. The "Tour mainstreet" polygon has 7 vertices with small notches.
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: Tour mainstreet about 41.9 x 24.7 m, Tour Casa Anfa about 38.9 x 23.0 m, Le Metropolitain about 21.3 x 15.7 m. Long axes bearing about 20 deg, so the towers are long north-south along the grid.
inventory.massing: Twin 22-storey slabs with a low 6-8-storey block between them. No other massing information found.
inventory.facade: unknown; the CBT site only says "modern"
inventory.distinctive: Twin towers facing the CFC Tower across Main Street, about 125-160 m east of it.
inventory.conflict: CTBUH lists "Casa Anfa Tower 1/2" at an estimated 51 m with 15 floors and residential use, with renderings credited to Hamonic+Masson. That record does not match the OSM "Tour Casa Anfa" (22 levels / 90 m office) and may be a different project, such as the Walili lot 65-2 residential (about 50 m) by Hamonic+Masson. Unresolved.

inventory.name: M Tower
inventory.owner_occupant: Developers Mfadel Group and Red Med Real Estate; offices for sale or lease
inventory.plan_shape: unknown. Described as a "dynamic spiral" design.
inventory.footprint_m: unknown: not present in the OSM data retrieved
inventory.massing: Spiral/twisting tower on an independent 3-level commercial podium (restaurants, wellness centre). Rooftop gastronomic restaurant reached by a panoramic lift. Two independent lobbies.
inventory.distinctive: Spiral form; panoramic external lift to the rooftop restaurant. HQE/EDGE targeted.
inventory.location_note: On Bd de l'Aéropostale, next to La Palmeraie (1,500-space car park). OSM neighbourhood node "La Palmeraie" is at about x=-319, z=336.5, given as context only, not the tower position.

inventory.name: Walili Tower
inventory.owner_occupant: unknown. Presumably Groupe Walili (a Casa Anfa developer), unconfirmed.
inventory.status: under construction per the Wikipedia list

height_m.note: Single source: the Wikipedia list (table entry)

inventory.footprint_m: OSM way "Walili Tower" is a 4-vertex polygon about 83.7 x 80.3 m (about 6,700 m2), probably the plot or podium outline rather than the tower shaft. No height tag.

inventory.name: Shift Tower
inventory.status: under construction per the Wikipedia list
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: about 48.6 x 44.6 m (about 2,090 m2), possibly the podium or plot outline. No height tag.

inventory.name: Cross Tower (OSM name only)
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: about 74.0 x 66.7 m polygon (about 4,900 m2), likely the plot or podium outline
inventory.note: No web source found for a "Cross Tower" in Casa Anfa

inventory.name: Capital Tower (OSM name only)

height_m.note: OSM tag only; no web confirmation found

inventory.footprint_m: OSM: about 50.1 x 29.3 m, about 1,360 m2, long axis bearing about 58 deg

inventory.name: BO 52 (BÔ 52)
inventory.owner_occupant: Linkcity Maroc (Bouygues Construction group), residential with a small office component. General contractor: Bymaro.

height_m.note: OSM tag on the taller building only

floors.value: two buildings of 16 and 13 floors + 3 basements

inventory.architect: Yachar Bouhaya Architecte, Saad El Kabbaj, Driss Kettani, Mohamed Amine Siana (Ayda Bennani Smires also credited)
inventory.plan_shape: Two irregular slab blocks (OSM: 5- and 6-vertex polygons that share an edge)
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: about 50.9 x 23.3 m (16-level block) and about 51.6 x 32.7 m (second block)
inventory.massing: 16- and 13-storey residential blocks just south of the CFC Tower
inventory.facade: Light/white treatment inspired by Casablanca's 20th-century (Art Deco/modernist) architecture. No detailed materials published.
inventory.distinctive: Unit counts conflict between sources: 145, 153 and 168 apartments.

inventory.name: Luxuria Tower
inventory.owner_occupant: CGI (Compagnie Generale Immobiliere, CDG group). Luxury residential, 50 or 61 apartments (sources conflict).
inventory.status: completed or near-complete (sales launched Dec 2019; current status not verified)

floors.value: R+15 tower part + R+4 lower part

inventory.plan_shape: Long rectangle (OSM about 69 x 18.5 m) split into a tall and a low part
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: whole about 69.2 x 18.5 m. Tall part about 33.2 x 18.5 m (16 levels); low part 5 levels.
inventory.massing: Slab with a 16-level end and a 5-level end. Rooftop gym, solarium and infinity pool.
inventory.distinctive: Faces Anfa Park on the "Axe Metropolitain"; plot 1,792 m2

inventory.name: CFC Bridge (OSM), probably the lots 57-58 office building
inventory.owner_occupant: Offices. PwC is listed at "CFC Lot 57, Casa Anfa"; IBIS at "4th floor, Lot 57-58, CFC Bridge Tower". Client of the AWM lots 58/65-1 scheme: Casablanca Finance City.
inventory.status: mapped in OSM; completion year unknown

floors.value: R+6 next to the tower (AWM lot 58 design, 2017 consultation), with a small taller element on the SW topped by a PV roof

inventory.architect: AWM Architectes Urbanistes (Mountassir) for lots 58 and 65-1. The link to the OSM "CFC Bridge" is probable but not confirmed.
inventory.plan_shape: Concave 6-vertex polygon wrapping the west and north of the CFC Tower. Two bodies linked by a footbridge (hence "Bridge"); open ground floor with a pedestrian passage.
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: about 74.9 x 67.6 m extent, about 2,970 m2
inventory.massing: Low (R+6) so as not to compete with the tower
inventory.distinctive: Footbridge between two bodies. The south and west sides open onto a pedestrian mall and the palm grove.

inventory.name: Les Tours Vegetales / The Gardens of Anfa (Jardins d'Anfa)
inventory.owner_occupant: Yasmine Signature (Anfa Club), residential plus one office tower
inventory.status: mapped in OSM as 4 buildings of 16 levels. Permit 2013, completion planned 2017; actual completion not verified.

alternatives: Tour Jasmin (Yasmine Signature office, also by Edouard Francois) reported as 8 floors

inventory.architect: Maison Edouard Francois, with Groupe 3 Architectes as local architect
inventory.massing: Towers in a palm-planted park with low residential blocks around them
inventory.facade: Planted facades: white jasmine or multicoloured bougainvillea covering the surfaces. Tour Jasmin is described as having an organic form and about 70% glazing.

inventory.name: Anfa Aerocity (OSM addr:housename)
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: about 101.7 x 86.6 m polygon (about 7,600 m2), likely a whole block outline

inventory.name: Aeria Mall
inventory.owner_occupant: Shopping mall (aeriamall.com), with the Aeria Palmeraie park beside it
inventory.footprint_m: OSM: about 164 x 115 m, about 12,700 m2
inventory.distinctive: A 2018 article describes a 42,000 m2 leisure/shopping centre planned on the former airport terminal site, keeping the terminal and the first control tower. OSM has a small concrete man_made=tower (tower:type=watchtower, about 9 x 8 m, way 1308152369) centred at about x=-205.5, z=148.5, footprint [[-206.5,144],[-210,149.5],[-204,152.5],[-201.5,147]]; it may be the preserved old control tower, unverified.

inventory.name: Radisson Blu / Radisson RED / Radisson Blu aparthotel complex (Mfadel Group)
inventory.owner_occupant: Mfadel Group, operated by Radisson Hotel Group. 383 keys: Radisson Blu 5* (131 rooms), Radisson RED 4* (177 rooms), aparthotel (77 keys), plus a conference centre.
inventory.distinctive: Presented as the first hotel component of Casa Anfa / CFC

checked_not_in_district.name: ANP Tower (Agence Nationale des Ports HQ)
checked_not_in_district.finding: NOT in Casa Anfa. It is opposite the Casa-Port train station near the port, outside the modelled bbox. 105 m, 25 floors, built 2017-2020 by TGCC (Wikipedia list says 2021).

checked_not_in_district.name: Africa50 HQ
checked_not_in_district.finding: Inaugurated Sept 2018. A French-language report places the inauguration at the Casablanca Marina, not Casa Anfa; no Africa50 building was found in Casa Anfa.

checked_not_in_district.name: CDG
checked_not_in_district.finding: No CDG tower found in Casa Anfa. CDG acts through its subsidiaries AUDA (the Casa Anfa master developer) and CGI (Luxuria Tower, The Corner).

checked_not_in_district.name: Hyatt
checked_not_in_district.finding: No Hyatt was found in Casa Anfa. The Hyatt Regency Casablanca is downtown (Place des Nations Unies); this is general knowledge, not re-verified in this research.

checked_not_in_district.name: Barcelo Anfa
checked_not_in_district.finding: 206-room hotel on Boulevard d'Anfa, which is not inside CFC per the search results

checked_not_in_district.name: "Ivoire" towers
checked_not_in_district.finding: No source found for any "Ivoire" tower in Casa Anfa / CFC

checked_not_in_district.name: BMCE Bank of Africa tower
checked_not_in_district.finding: Planned in the CFC business district but abandoned (HQ moved to Rabat), per a 2018 article

checked_not_in_district.name: Lot 57
checked_not_in_district.finding: An address (CFC Lot 57 / Lot 57-58, "CFC Bridge Tower"), not a separate tower. See cfc_bridge.
